title: UK Modern Slavery Statements Registry (by Company Number) — filters

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current statement summaries (default), or only those added or changed since a date — schedule a daily run in changes mode to watch your supplier list and pay only for what changed.

since.title: Changes since
since.description: Changes mode only: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 7 days. The feed keeps 90 days.

change.title: Change type
change.description: Changes mode only: one kind of change. Default: all three.

company_number.title: Company number
company_number.description: Companies House number as the registry writes it, e.g. 00445790 or SC123456 — every statement covering the company.

parent_name.title: Group parent contains
parent_name.description: Members of group statements submitted by this parent (case-insensitive substring).

statement_year.title: Registry year
statement_year.description: Only statements filed under this registry year, e.g. 2026.

turnover_band.title: Turnover band contains
turnover_band.description: E.g. "Over £500 million" or "£36 million to £60 million".

group_submission.title: Group statements only
group_submission.description: Tick for statements that cover a group of organisations.

includes_due_diligence.title: Covers due diligence
includes_due_diligence.description: Tick for statements that say they cover due diligence.

includes_training.title: Covers training
includes_training.description: Tick for statements that say they cover training.

last_updated_after.title: Updated on or after
last_updated_after.description: Only summaries last updated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many statement summaries (you are charged per result).
